sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 3; Internal Quality Checks row 3; Deterministic Checks check-instruction-content.py and check-instruction-hygiene.py)
evidence: Static review of the brief (instruction.md, 5 lines) and all six notes, read in full. SPELLING: every distinct word in the seven files was listed and read; no misspelling found. British spelling is used consistently (behaviour: policy.md:5, ui.md:3; Colour/coloured/Colouring: ui.md:13); no American variant of the same words appears. No doubled words seen. CONTAMINATION: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem|{{|${ returned nothing; the template's 'CHANGE_ME' stubs (template instruction.md:1, notes.md:1) are fully replaced. No drive letters, /home, /Users, /tmp, ~ or URLs; the only paths are the contract paths /app, /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /app/node_modules, /api/health. No author asides, QC/round/candidate wording, or grader vocabulary (judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|gate|golden) in any of the seven files. No duplicated paragraph. CONTRADICTIONS checked and none found: instruction.md:3 'the six notes in /instructions' = six files copied by environment/Dockerfile 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/'; 'port 3000 ... (PORT is set to 3000 at launch)' (integration.md:3) = test.sh:108 PORT="3000"; 'Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH' (integration.md:5) = Dockerfile node:22 and NODE_PATH; one database path with one override (integration.md:9) = test.sh:109 DB_PATH; one seed path, stated identically in instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7, and seed_data.json really has 'snippets': []; one run budget ('five-second', behaviour.md:5 twice) and a separate, non-conflicting library refresh window ('about five seconds', behaviour.md:11); no-sign-in stated consistently (instruction.md:5, overview.md:3, policy.md:3); library allowances consistent (policy.md:3, ui.md:3, ui.md:15); textarea/input ban and the 'small input solely for keyboard or clipboard plumbing' allowance sit in the same paragraph and do not conflict; security.md network ban is scoped to the preview while behaviour.md:13 'ordinary HTTP requests from the page' is scoped to the app page. Counterexample attempts: (a) a builder misled by a stray value - none exists, every number has one value; (b) a conforming app failed because two notes disagree - no pair of statements found that cannot both be satisfied. NOTES (not defects for this row): N1 integration.md:3 says 'I start it with node /app/server.js' while test.sh:97-100 may instead start a copy ($APP_COPY/server.js) when /app is not writable; the brief already covers this with 'Resolve files from their actual location' (integration.md:3) and 'including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app' (integration.md:9), so it is a loose phrase rather than a contradiction. N2 behaviour.md:3 has one long sentence ('...with a one-based line number for a thrown error, including an error inside a complete HTML file, counted from the first line of that file, and a Promise rejection that nothing handles; ...') where it is unclear whether the line number is also required for the unhandled rejection; this is a clarity point for the ambiguity row, not a spelling or contamination defect. N3 restart durability is stated three times (behaviour.md:9, integration.md:7, integration.md:9) and the seed sentence twice; the statements agree, so this is repetition, not a pasted duplicate. N4 behaviour.md:5 'until that run settles' does not say what happens to a run that never settles (self-rescheduling timer); the criteria treat it as a time-limit case, consistent with the text, but this belongs to the ambiguity row. This row is a static text check; no runtime measurement is required for it and none is claimed. The private check-instruction-content.py / check-instruction-hygiene.py were not executed; their documented behaviour was applied by hand.
